description: A utility class for processing OFBiz command line arguments, defining startup options, parsing commands, and displaying help messages.

classes.name: StartupCommandUtil
classes.description: A utility class for handling OFBiz startup command line options and commands.

classes.name: StartupOption
classes.description: Enum representing various OFBiz startup options such as help, load data, shutdown, start, status, and test.

methods.name: parseOfbizCommands
methods.description: Parses command line arguments into a list of StartupCommand objects, handling exceptions.

methods.name: printOfbizStartupHelp
methods.description: Prints help message for OFBiz startup commands.

methods.name: highlightAndPrintErrorMessage
methods.description: Prints an error message with visual separators.

methods.name: getOfbizStartupOptions
methods.description: Defines and returns the set of command line options for OFBiz startup.

methods.name: mapCommonsCliOptionsToStartupCommands
methods.description: Converts parsed command line options into a list of StartupCommand objects.

methods.name: populateMapFromProperties
methods.description: Converts Properties object to a Map<String, String>.

methods.name: validateAllCommandArguments
methods.description: Validates command line arguments, ensuring no unrecognized options and correct port offset values.
